name: KDE Plasma 6
tagline: The modern, endlessly tweakable Linux desktop — anchored by Breeze blue.
description: KDE Plasma 6 is the current generation of the KDE community's flagship desktop — a fast, deeply customizable Linux environment built on Qt 6 and Wayland. Its Breeze design language centers on a single bright accent blue, the color that tints highlights, links, and the default desktop across the Plasma 6 series.

colors.name: Breeze Blue
colors.note: The Breeze accent blue — KDE Plasma's default desktop and highlight color.
